name: Trigger.dev
solves: Provides a managed platform and TypeScript SDK for background jobs, long-running tasks, and AI agent workflows with local/dev parity, automatic retries, queues, and no Redis/worker infrastructure to operate yourself.
best_for: TypeScript apps needing long-running or AI-agent workflows without babysitting workers
Teams that want managed queues, observability, and retries with a great local DX
Next.js/serverless products that outgrew cron hacks but do not want Redis+BullMQ ops
Durable multi-step jobs with structured logging and dashboards
Builders who want an open SDK with a hosted execution plane
skip_when: You must run a fully self-hosted queue inside your own VPC with no SaaS control plane
You already standardized on BullMQ/Redis or pg-boss and do not want another platform
You need multi-language workers beyond the TypeScript-centric SDK
Budget or procurement blocks a hosted job platform
